about.title: About us
about.description: AgroFlet is a Peruvian technology startup that improves visibility, control and traceability of the land transport of food.
about.mission: Make coordination easier between those who dispatch and those who receive food, through shared logistics information and records of every operation.
about.vision: Become an alternative for managing and tracing agri-food transport in Peru, with regional expansion subject to the validation of the business model.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.description: Conditions, scope of the service and contact channel of the AgroFlet web application.
terms.simulation-notice: This version is an academic prototype that works with a Fake API. It is not an operating logistics service: positions, routes and notifications are demonstrative and do not replace official waybills or GPS tracking.

sections.title: 1. Scope of the service
sections.content: AgroFlet lets dispatchers register agricultural transport operations, assign vehicles and drivers, report incidents and positions; and lets buyers check the shipments addressed to them.

sections.title: 2. Accounts and roles
sections.content: Each account has one role (dispatcher or buyer). The role defines the available actions and cannot be changed from the profile. Users are responsible for keeping their credentials confidential.

sections.title: 3. Geographic information
sections.content: The map distinguishes the planned route from the reported positions. Each position shows its date and source; the existence of a map does not imply continuous GPS tracking, and the user's office location is never attributed to the truck.

sections.title: 4. Personal data
sections.content: Personal data is processed according to Peruvian Law N.° 29733 on Personal Data Protection. Buyers never see the national ID (DNI) of drivers.

sections.title: 5. Availability
sections.content: Functions that are still planned are identified as such and are not presented as implemented. Prices shown on the landing page are proposals and do not create charges or subscriptions.

sections.title: 6. Accessibility
sections.content: AgroFlet targets WCAG 2.1 level AA: keyboard navigation, visible focus, labelled form fields, text alternatives and statuses that never rely on color alone (icon, text and color). The interface is available in English (United States) and Spanish (Latin America).

sections.title: 7. Professional ethics
sections.content: The team builds AgroFlet following the ACM/IEEE Software Engineering Code of Ethics and the Code of Ethics of the Colegio de Ingenieros del Perú (CIP): acting in the public interest, never presenting demonstrative data as real, protecting the privacy of users and drivers, and reporting the limitations of the product transparently.

vehicles.title: Vehicles
vehicles.description: Own or contracted vehicles available for your shipments.
vehicles.form-description: Plate, capacity and body type determine which shipments the vehicle can carry.
vehicles.empty-description: Register a vehicle to assign it to your shipments.
vehicles.locked-notice: This vehicle is held by an active shipment: its status and capacity cannot be changed until the shipment is delivered or cancelled.

drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.description: Drivers responsible for the transport and their availability.
drivers.form-description: Identity, license and contact data of the driver.
drivers.empty-description: Register a driver to assign them to your shipments.

history.title: Shipment history
history.description: Search by shipment code or vehicle plate and combine filters by date, status, cargo and destination.
history.empty-description: No operations match the criteria entered. Clear the filters to see the full list.

form.title: Register shipment
form.description: Complete the cargo, route, buyer and resources. The shipment is created as planned.
form.cargo-placeholder: e.g. Yellow potato in 50 kg bags
form.resources-hint: Only available resources can be selected. Unavailable ones show their current status.
form.reservation-note: The selection is provisional: the vehicle and driver are reserved only when you confirm the shipment.
form.created-detail: The vehicle and driver were reserved.

detail.not-found-description: The shipment does not exist or is not associated with your account.
detail.terminal-notice: This operation is closed and cannot be reopened.

start.message: Confirm the effective departure of {code}. The shipment will change to in transit.

deliver.message: Confirm that {code} was unloaded at destination. The vehicle and driver will be released.

cancel.title: Cancel {code}
cancel.warning: A cancelled operation cannot be reopened. The vehicle and driver will be released.

tracking.map-label: Map with planned routes and reported positions
tracking.no-position: Location not available: no position has been reported for this shipment.
tracking.no-position-description: Positions appear when the dispatcher registers a location received from the driver.
tracking.stale-message: Last reported position is outdated. Last update: {date}.
tracking.route-unavailable: Planned route not available. The shipment data is kept.
tracking.route-summary: Reference line between origin and destination (≈ {km} km in a straight line). It is not the path actually travelled.
tracking.disclaimer: The map shows the planned route and the positions reported with their date and source. It is not continuous GPS tracking.
tracking.register-hint: Enter the coordinates received from the driver or a checkpoint. Your own location is never used as the truck position.

incidents.register-hint: Report an event that affects {code}. The estimated arrival is recalculated once.
incidents.eta-updated: The estimated arrival was updated and the participants were notified.
incidents.empty-description: No incidents have been reported for this shipment.

notifications.created-message: A new shipment was planned for you.
